acceptance: deploy/README.md says how to recognise a Pages-side failure (artifact unchanged, failure inside the Deploy to GitHub Pages step) and to retry with a fresh mode=deploy dispatch rather than a job rerun, naming the duplicate github-pages artifact error
It states what the fresh run deploys (the current main commit with the resolved bundle) so the operator knows when a redeploy is the right mode instead
The page passes markdownlint and cspell
context:
Noticed 2026-11-06 while recovering the deploy of PR #119. Failure issue #58 and core issue BenchBox-dev/benchbox#3973 carry the recovery note.

2026-11-07: Done in PR #129 (merge 145ac26c0e). deploy/README.md gains 'Retrying a Pages-side failure' after 'Redeploy': how to recognise the failure (artifact unchanged, failure inside Deploy to GitHub Pages, no probe or rollback), the duplicate github-pages artifact error that makes `gh run rerun --failed` fail, a fresh `gh workflow run deploy.yml --ref main -f mode=deploy` as the retry, what that run deploys, and when mode=redeploy is the right mode. Facts checked against runs 42278553437, 42279882633 and 42281848276.
description: On 2026-11-06 two deploy runs for site commit 92c910f3d6 failed inside GitHub Pages (run 42278553437 stalled at syncing_files until the 10-minute deploy-pages timeout; run 42279882633 was cancelled by Pages after 7 seconds). Rerunning the failed job of 42279882633 with `gh run rerun --failed` cannot succeed: actions/deploy-pages then fails with 'Multiple artifacts named "github-pages" were unexpectedly found for this workflow run'. A fresh `gh workflow run deploy.yml --ref main -f mode=deploy` (run 42281848276) deployed the same commit and bundle. Neither deploy/README.md nor AGENTS.md says how to retry a deploy after a Pages-side failure.
